headline: Digjam notifies the exchange about a change in its registrar and share transfer agent
summary: Digjam Limited has formally notified the stock exchange regarding an update concerning its Registrar and Share Transfer Agent (RTA). The filing covers procedural changes related to shareholder record maintenance. Such updates are routine corporate housekeeping matters required under SEBI regulations. For retail investors, this administrative change has no bearing on the company's financial performance or stock fundamentals.
why_it_matters: No financial impact on your shareholdings.

headline: Digjam Limited reports financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
hook: September quarter numbers are now out
summary: Digjam Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the period ending September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. These filings provide the latest operational and financial performance update for the company. Retail investors holding the stock can review the disclosures to assess revenue, profit margins, and overall financial health. The filing offers standard compliance data for the recent quarter.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data available for Digjam shareholders.
